notes.title: Campido - Update - Version 1.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.png[/img][b][h3]A Massive change in terms of graphics and user experience.[/h3][/b]
- Menu Effects / Animation
- Game UI Effects / Animation
- Card Animation

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/lOIvyyDGDn8EvoL4UQ/giphy.webp[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.png[/img][b][h3]New Classic Mode[/h3][/b]
-Play the classic version of Campido (Stage 5) straight away without progressing through the campaign.

[img]https://i.giphy.com/media/cKthLCgfuzQaV1QHJc/giphy.webp[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.png[/img][b][h3]New Skins[/h3][/b]
-Play as the cat or the husky, dress as an exotic merchant from the orient.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/427c6cbdacdecce5bccef7da5836aecc204f9d57.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/4b2bc7284ade9024db17990489e9138bbcfd1522.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.png[/img][b][h3]New Music[/h3][/b]
-You may now enjoy 5 new additional tracks which may shuffle along each match by random.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.png[/img][b][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][/b]
- Coins Multiplier changed to 2 (From 0), 
- Boogaloo card may replace only some of the cards.
- Match freezing in some rare cases.
- A sporadic issue in which cards are not being "Disposed" when discarded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.png[/img][b][h3]Misc[/h3][/b]
- The game was unpublished from Google Play Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.png[/img][b][h3]An Apology[/h3][/b]
Fixing some of the things in Campido took some time (a whole lot of time).
These delays & Lack of response to feedback is something a customer should not endure.
These issues will hopefully not reoccur in the future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33858593/875166c66844e3b4b4ea885c5f65dc6474704e4b.png[/img][b][h3]Feedback[/h3][/b]
-Please share your thoughts, suggestions, issues with the game. Each and every response/review is more than helpful and highly appreciated.

[b][h1]Have fun![/h1][/b]
